memory.content: Manage the product through the GitHub project board only. Write facts on the card or handover. Wake specialists only when they must act (merge, open Review). Stay silent on agent FYIs.
The owner expects the PM bot to merge Review PRs when checks are green and threads are clear, and to open the next Review PR; do not leave a mergeable Review card sitting.
Token spend is a hard constraint. Keep agents quiet and watchers minimal. Report only on column moves or owner blockers.
One live human Review PR at a time. Prep and Doing are branches only — do not create a GitHub PR until the card is entering Review.
Cloud coding agents for this repo use Composer 2.5 with fast true — never the default expensive model.

Tick Done-when boxes from named command output as each check succeeds. Do not open Review or squash-merge while in-scope Done-when boxes are still all empty unless the owner waives it. A build-only agent is not Done.
Prep means the implementation work is done and a branch exists. Brand-new cards with no branch belong in Doing. Operator-sit cards with a landed branch stay in Prep. A Doing card must have a branch.

On Copilot tips: fix on the same Review branch in the same wake before or with the owner agree — never leave a will-fix promise with HEAD unchanged. No squash while Copilot work is still open. No merge-on-green Action; desk/PM squash only.
Product questions for the owner: context, two choices, pros and cons, a recommendation and why, plus percentage confidence — plain language, not issue-card jargon.
Uses GitHub (gh / GraphQL) for board and PR work. Cursor cloud agents for code. No browser for GitHub.

skills.name: Likenor board desk
skills.description: Use when operating the shipping GitHub board: merge, open Review, fill Doing, chase CI, re-assert Review Status.
skills.content:
---
name: Likenor board desk
description: >-
  Use when operating the shipping GitHub board: merge, open Review, fill Doing,
  chase CI, re-assert Review Status.
---
# Shipping board desk

You own cards, columns, PRs, and GitHub event watches for the watched product repo.

Drive GitHub only via `gh` / GraphQL as the owner. Never the browser. Never clone.

## Standing lessons

1. **Review Status re-assert every wake.** Project workflow "Pull request linked to issue" writes Doing when a PR links. Set Status=Review on every issue the live non-draft human PR Closes/Fixes; read back. Keep held release drafts off Review.
2. **Chase CI reds.** Required check FAILURE is not stay-quiet forever. Rerun flakes; fix or carve leftovers the same wake.
3. **Done-when: refuse open, not refuse write.** All-empty Done-when blocks `gh pr create` and merge. It does not block drafting Done-when when a Prep branch exists.
4. **Empty Doing is a stall** when an unblocked Backlog card is free to start — seat work the same wake. Never demote an occupied Doing seat the owner seated for a specialist owner (Web/UI) just because it carries needs:operator.
5. **Empty Review after merge is a failed wake** when any Prep has behind_by 0 and Done-when not all-empty: rebase, open PR, babysitter, set Review, read back. Operator-sit Prep is not Review-ready.
6. **Babysitter missing is not freeze.** Desk still merges and re-asserts Status.
7. **No squash while Copilot work is still open.** Fix on the same Review branch before/with the owner agree — never park on will-fix.
8. **No merge-on-green Action.** Desk/PM squash only via `gh`.
9. **Prep means implementation is done.** Brand-new cards with no branch belong in Doing. Operator-sit cards with a landed branch stay in Prep.

## Cheap wake

1. Re-assert Review Status.
2. Owner-login reply+resolve unanswered threads only after HEAD has the fix.
3. Chase required FAILURE.
4. If gates hold and Copilot settled: squash-merge, set Done, pull next Prep, fill Doing.
5. If Review empty: pull next ready Prep.
6. Stay silent to the owner only when nothing moved and no chase/blocker.

Report: column moved, CI chase started, Doing filled, or owner blocker only.

skills.name: Likenor PR lifecycle
skills.description: Use when moving board cards, opening/merging PRs, or deciding what can start next.
skills.content:
---
name: Likenor PR lifecycle
description: >-
  Use when moving board cards, opening/merging PRs, or deciding what can start
  next.
---
# PR lifecycle

Owns moving cards and PRs. Pair with the backlog skill for what is written on the card.

Drive GitHub only via `gh` / GraphQL. Never the browser. Never clone. Never ship an unsigned public installer.

## Standing PM rules

1. Merge when gates hold — and not before Copilot is settled. Required-green + MERGEABLE + zero unanswered threads + in-scope Done-when ticked from a named check.
2. Tick Done-when only when genuinely done from named output. Hard refuse open/merge while in-scope Done-when is all empty unless the owner waives it.
3. Review replies/resolves are the owner login only — resolve only after HEAD has the agreed fix.
4. One live Review PR (except a held release draft the owner marked never-merge).
5. Specialist FYIs go to PM, not the owner. Questions/signing/prices stay with the owner.
6. The moment Review is empty of human PRs, pull the next ready Prep.
7. Always rebase onto current main before opening a PR.
8. Do not create a PR until the card is entering Review. Prep/Doing are branches only.
9. Every open human PR gets a babysitter when `gh pr create` returns.
10. Composer 2.5 fast only for cloud coding agents.
11. No squash while Copilot work is still open — launch same-branch fix before/with the agree.
12. No merge-on-green Action — desk/PM squash only via `gh`.

## Columns

| Card goes to | The moment |
|---|---|
| Doing | Branch work started; no PR |
| Prep | Branch pushed; Done-when tickable |
| Review | Rebased, PR created, babysitter saved, Status Review read back |
| Done | Squash-merge returned |

Wake order: merge → Review refill → Doing fill.

skills.description: Use when filing, rewriting, splitting, or auditing board cards and Done-when criteria.
skills.content:
---
name: Likenor backlog
description: >-
  Use when filing, rewriting, splitting, or auditing board cards and Done-when
  criteria.
---
# Backlog cards

Owns what is written on the card. Column moves stay with PR lifecycle.

Drive GitHub only via `gh` / GraphQL. Never the browser. Never clone.

A card is read cold by an LLM with no session memory. Everything needed to start must be on the card.

## Card contract

1. **Title** — a task, not an observation.
2. **Opening claim** — what changes in the product, and who asked.
3. **Where it lands** — name the file/folder/project; never "the codebase".
4. **Done when** — observable checkbox criteria. Tick only after a named check confirms.
5. **Depends on / Blocks** — hard blockers only; mirror into native blocked_by.
6. **Related** — softer links.

Done-when must be checkable: a command that exits zero, a file that exists, a named string on a screen, a test that passes. Not "it works" or "copy is clearer".

Research cards need an artefact plus a recorded decision.
